title: Admin control and compact dashboard
items: Admin-managed app settings: texts and options in the customer and pro apps now come from the admin panel, so changes go live without a new app release.
Service images are managed from the admin panel and shown across the customer app.
Admin dashboard redesigned to be compact: all key numbers in one panel, a status bar for bookings, and shorter charts that fit on one screen.
Insights panels across admin pages made more compact.
Customer app home header made compact; the banner and up-next list now scroll together with the page.
Admin sign-in on phones: the animated scene now sits behind the form, with a soft overlay so the fields stay clear.
Responsive fix: the shop price filter no longer causes sideways scrolling on small phones.
New app builds: Customer app 1.0.2 and Pro app 1.0.1 are available to download at the top of this page.

title: Pro app polish and delivery tools
items: Pro app: glass-style top bar and bottom bar, refreshed sign-in and forgot-password screens, rating popup and new loaders.
Customer app: OTP popup and booking flow refinements; notifications improved.
Local Android build script for the pro app, so test builds can be produced quickly.
Fixzy Overview page: added a product demo video and made the page self-contained for sharing.

title: Provider app redesign and live service
items: Provider app redesigned: sign-in, My jobs, Account and the live job status bar.
In-app chat between the customer and the assigned professional.
Live map tracking now continues while the job is in progress.
Smarter dispatch: online professionals are preferred, nearest first.
Provider payout ledger added.
Safety check: release app builds refuse to use a local or test server address.

title: Admin panel overhaul
items: New admin look: glass-style bars, redesigned login, cleaner tables with filters and simple status chips.
Insights panel on each admin page, remembering whether it is collapsed.
Coupons shown as ticket-style cards.
Home-screen banners managed from the admin panel.
Client build delivery: app builds can be published to the Fixzy Overview page for download.

title: Payments and notifications
items: Push notifications for booking updates.
Booking payments.
Coupons that customers can apply to bookings.
